methods.label: Point-to-plane distance formula
methods.explanation: The numerator is \(|1+2+2-6|=1\), and the denominator is \(\sqrt{1+4+4}=3\), so the distance is \(1/3\).
methods.levelReason: Directly applies the elective point-to-plane distance formula using a normal magnitude and an absolute value.
